title: Inshore multispecious fishing in Egersund
description: Enjoy 5 hours fishing from shore, targeting a variety of species local to Egersund. You can keep any legal catch and Øystein can cook it for you after the trip if you wish so. Ready to have the whole family unplug? Then you'll be glad to know that kids are more than welcome.

gear_description: You don't have to bring anything but good clothes and suitable footwear - I will provide you with all the eqiupment you need.

title: Fishing adventure in sweden around Stockholm
description:
Dan Bjurshammar Fishing offers 2 different fishing packages:
1 full day of fishing with fishing guide all-inclusive.

2: Incooperation with Rastaholm Inn (Ekerö), fishing packages nr 2 that include overnight accommodation, a breakfast bag, and bed linen at the inn, as well as a full day with a fishing guide.

Now only 2990 SEK per person (example price based on 4 people), which includes accommodation, bed linen and breakfast bag, a fully equipped fishing boat, a fishing guide, and lunch.

Great fishing for pike, zander, and perch.

We offer accommodation in the hostel where a sauna is also available. Near the hostel you will find the restaurant and bar.

There is also access to a grill area right by the shore of Lake Mälaren, with a magical view.

Free parking is available.

Up to 58 beds can be arranged, making it suitable both for small groups and corporate events.

So we welcome both local and long-distance guests to a wonderful fishing adventure.

Please email or call to express your interest.

Kind regards,
Dan Bjurshammar

title: Fishing for Zander, Perch and Pike around Alingsås, near Gothenburg
description:
Welcome to Fishing Guide Sweden! Since 2018, I have been working as a fishing guide, mainly on the lakes Mjörn, Anten, and Sävelången in the municipality of Alingsås, about 50 km east of Gothenburg.

Anyone can book a guided fishing trip — beginners, hobby anglers, or professionals. Families with children are also very welcome. The main target species are pike, zander, and perch.

The day is tailored to the client’s experience and level of ambition, and I provide all the necessary equipment. In addition, I have partners with whom I offer larger guided packages for companies.

We have fantastic zander fishing in Lake Mjörn and the chance to catch very large pike and zander in Lake Anten. In several forest lakes, there is also the possibility of catching perch weighing close to 2 kilograms.

Popular methods include spinning, trolling, and vertical fishing. For more advanced anglers looking for really big zander or pike, I offer spot casting with Active Target.

The maximum number of guests is three, excluding myself. It is also possible to request a quote for longer fishing trips or larger groups.

Visit the gallery to see previous catches and build your appetite for fishing!
food_description: Bring your own food and drinks

title: Fishing & Nature Experience in Southern Norway
description:
Do you have a free day or weekend and don't know what to do with your time? Instead of sitting at home, join me for a real fishing adventure around Kristiansand! My name is Marcin, and fishing is my absolute passion. Whether you are coming alone or with your family and kids, we will spend some truly special moments together.

When you step out into the Norwegian wild with me, you are signing up for absolute silence, raw nature, and crystal-clear waters. This isn't just about catching local favourites like cod, saithe, mackerel, flounder, and wolffish—it's a total mental reset and a chance to completely detach from everyday life. Expect to leave the city noise behind, recharge your batteries, and even take your fresh catch home to enjoy a taste you simply cannot buy in a shop. I organise one-day, weekend, and multi-day trips tailored to you. You just bring a smile and a good mood, and I will take care of the rest!
location_description: A beautiful fjord with many islands and a boat with a fishing spirit
boat_description: We sail a sea boat with a fishing spirit, fishing with spinning, bottom fishing, and trolling. You can count on beautiful views.
license_description: Fishing in Norway sea is completly free, so you don't have to worry about a license
gear_description: Fishing rods, bait, life jackets and my guidance are available.
transport_description: I can pick you up at the airport and drop you off after your trip. Transportation is available for an additional fee upon request. Oslo Sandefjord-Torp Airport or Stavanger Airport

title: Guided fishing tours on the Baltic sea coast
description: Guided trip dedicated for fly & spin anglers with good physical condition. Be prepared for walking long distance in waders and warm clothes on. But the reward is worth all our sacrifices!
location_description: Sea coast fishing with fly and spin rod
food_description: Simple lunch and coffee/water included. Bring your own snacks and energy bars.
gear_description: Bring your own rods/baits and chest waders/boots
transport_description: Exactly meeting point will be send after trip booking.

title: Salmon fishing in Kalix
description:
Fishing for salmon is not always easy — and it can be even harder when you arrive at a new river. Where are the best spots? What’s working right now? Where does the salmon stop, and where does it bite?

I have fished these rivers for many years, and I have chosen to dedicate myself fully to guiding, where the customer’s wishes and experience are my top priority. I do everything I can to help you hook your dream fish, while also making sure you are comfortable during the sometimes long fishing sessions.

Tell me your preferences and I will create a tailored package for you.

There is an incredible amount of water to fish within a reasonable driving distance.
Within a radius of about 150 km, you’ll find for example:

Kalix River
Lainio River
Ängesån
Torne River
How long does it take to get here?
From Stockholm by plane, you can be out fishing in one of the rivers within 3–4 hours, depending on where we choose to start.

title: Boat fishing with Berra (famous angler)
description:
Welcome to a fantastic fishing experience in the archipelago, lake Mälaren, Vättern or Vänern. 
We fish pike, zander, perch, salmon, sea trout, trout or char. All according to your wishes.  

Berra Mårdh has 35 years of experience in fishing from the boat and all certificates needed. Everything  for a successful fishing trip is included, rods, reels, baits and more, as well as overalls and life jackets.  

Coffee, cookies and cold drinks are also included. We cook lunch on a Muurika pan and I make stew in the pan, hamburgers or pork loin. I also make other requests.

title: Icelandic Trout fishing trip
description:
Iceland is one of the last places in Europe where truly wild, untouched rivers still run through open volcanic landscapes with barely another angler in sight. This is exactly where I take you.
Together we chase brown trout and sea trout in the pristine highland rivers around Hella in southern Iceland. These fish are something special — powerful, brilliantly coloured and completely wild. The kind you remember long after you're home.
I guide anglers of all experience levels. If you've never held a fly rod before, I'll get you casting and catching. If you're a seasoned angler chasing a personal best, I know exactly which waters give you the best chance. We fish at the pace that suits you, in some of the most dramatic scenery you'll ever see from a riverbank.
As a Fishpartner guide, I can also help organise your full trip to Iceland, so getting here and making the most of your time on the water is as smooth as possible.
Tight lines are guaranteed. Trophy fish are very much on the cards.

title: Experience Iceland Guided Fly Fishing in Iceland with a Local guide
description:
World-Class Fly Fishing, Tailored to You.
Experience Iceland's waters on your terms. With access to some of the finest salmon, brown trout, and Arctic char rivers on the planet, I design custom itineraries built around your goals. Contact me today, and let's start planning your perfect Icelandic fishing trip.

itinerary.label: Area where the river meets the sea, Sea Trout fishing at it's finest

All Transportation Included
Leave the driving to me. Your trip includes pick-up and drop-off in Reykjavík, transportation to and from our fishing destination, and all driving between pools on the river or lake throughout our stay.

title: World-class trout fishing in one of Norway’s most beautiful rivers - Mistra
description:
Fishing with member of Rapala  Proguide Norway,  targeting trophy trout in Norway’s finest trout river — the Mistra. This wild and beautiful river stretches for nearly 30 kilometers through untouched wilderness. As early as May and June, large trout begin their migration upstream from Lake Storsjøen, creating outstanding opportunities for anglers seeking truly big fish.
The river offers incredible variety, from powerful rapids and deep pools to calm, slow-moving stretches in the upper sections — perfect habitat for large, wild trout.
gear_description: You do not need any of your own gear. As a Rapala Pro-Guide, I provide all the necessary, high-quality rods and baits we need to trigger the big trout.

title: Trout fishing in icelandic river
description:
Fly fishing guide by day, Fly tying by night — and salmon fanatic always. That's me in a nutshell. I'm Magnús Haukur, an Icelandic fly fishing guide with a simple philosophy: long live the salmon.
My sessions take place on Iceland's coastal flats and rivers, wading in search of sea trout and salmon with a fly rod in hand. From the photos you can see the kind of fish these waters produce — heavy, silver-flanked sea trout caught in stunning Icelandic settings, often with mountains and open sky stretching out behind you.
I fish in all conditions, in all seasons. Freezing coastal flats in winter, calm river bends at golden hour in summer — Iceland's fishing is unlike anywhere else, and I know how to make the most of every session regardless of what the weather throws at us.
When tying flies I make patterns built specifically for Icelandic conditions. When you're out with me, every detail is thought through.

title: Baltic Salmon Fishing on Tornion-Muonion River in Finnish Lapland
description:
The Tornio River, also known as the Tornion-Muonionjoki, is the largest free-flowing Salmon river in Europe, stretching approximately 510 kilometers from its source in the mountains of Sweden to the Gulf of Bothnia. 
The river forms a natural border between Sweden and Finland, making it a unique and significant waterway in the region. It is renowned for its pristine waters and stunning natural landscapes, offering a serene environment for fishing enthusiasts.
location_description: We operate from Base Camp Pello.
boat_description: Traditional river boat and modern day river boat.
accommodation_description: Whether you’re fishing for salmon, grayling, trout, pike, or perch right from your doorstep at Base Camp Ounas and Base Camp Pello, or just relaxing in the peaceful surroundings, our accommodations offer a perfect escape. If you prefer just the peacefulness, you can rent the cabin alone and immerse yourself in the tranquility.
food_description: You can enjoy grilling together at the end of the trip

title: Perch fishing on Saimaa Lake
description:
Casting for perch on lake Saimaa
Come and experience an unforgettable perch fishing trip on Lake Saimaa! Saimaa is renowned for its excellent perch population, and it truly offers the chance to catch a real “trophy-sized” perch.

During the trip, you will get to try various perch fishing methods under professional guidance. We maintain a relaxed atmosphere while tailoring the trip to the customers’ wishes and the prevailing conditions, making it perfect for both beginners and more experienced anglers.

Lake Saimaa provides the perfect setting for a memorable fishing experience: beautiful nature combined with exciting fishing for the unpredictable but rewarding perch. As Finland’s national fish, the perch is not only fun to catch but also an excellent food fish, the perfect crown for your day’s catch.
location_description:
Lake Saimaa is Finland’s largest lake, a true playground for anglers looking for variety, excitement, and unforgettable moments on the water. Its diverse fish populations and ever-changing conditions create the perfect setting for an exceptional fishing experience.
You can explore darker, nutrient-rich waters teeming with life, or venture into crystal-clear, rugged areas for a completely different challenge. Saimaa is home to strong populations of perch, zander, and northern pike. Giving you excellent chances for a great catch.
And there’s more: alongside Saimaa, the South Karelia region offers a wide selection of smaller lakes, each with its own character and fishing opportunities waiting to be discovered.
Lappeenranta serves as the perfect base, from here, you can easily access the best fishing spots across South Karelia and experience the region’s stunning waters in all their variety.

The stunning scenery of Lake Saimaa completes the adventure. At its best, you’ll be rewarded with incredible catches and lasting memories.

title: Live sonar fishing; Live from beneath the surface
description:
Join us for a relaxed yet exciting live sonar fishing adventure in South Karelia. On the legendary Lake Saimaa or one of its peaceful smaller lakes. Whether you’re after perch, pike, or zander, every trip is tailored to your wishes, giving you a real shot at the catch of a lifetime.

With modern live sonar technology, we don’t just wait for fish, we actively find them. This dynamic and increasingly popular method keeps things engaging while still maintaining a laid-back, enjoyable atmosphere on the water.

Surrounded by stunning Finnish nature, you’ll experience either the vast open scenery of Saimaa or the calm beauty of hidden lakes. For an extra thrill, we also offer night trips, when predatory fish are often at their most active.

This is fishing with a modern edge, combining skill, technology, and great company into an unforgettable experience.

description:
Great one day trip or weekend trip to Norwegian tundra, fishing for brown trout and arctic char. Great spot and easy access for some world class fishing. Trip will be customized with client. 
We can offer full package with all included or we can offer one day guided trips or if you want to experience wild tundra and sleep over night in campfire and tent ? Let me know! Suitable for all skill levels. Fishing time ( mid May to MId June ) or ( Sep / Oct )
location_description: Börselva is well known salmon river, but also offers some of the best trout and char fishing in early summer on small tundra lakes.

title: Sea trout fishing in Alta region ( coastal fishing ) ( May-June)
description: Sea Trout fishing in Alta region, coastal fishing with lure or fly. This is great fun and usually lots of fish in the fjords in May and June. Fishing is focusing on tidal waters and shallow reef areas.
location_description: Alta is one of the most famous salmon rivers in Norway, it has also great sea fishing out in the fjords. Great city and lovely small town.

title: Boat fishing on the lake (pike, zander, perch - day trip)
description:
A guiding day includes about 8 hours of active fishing. Coffee, snacks, and a simple lunch (hot dogs or luxury sandwich - night trip) are included in the fishing trip. New technology in the form of a Livescope sonar helps us locate the fish and see all the action beneath the water's surface. The preferred fishing methods are vertical fishing, casting, or jigging for perch. See you on board!
Lakes in range of 50km around Olofström/Blekinge.
